syllabus.head: Interference
syllabus.text: Coherent sources, Conditions of interference, Fresnel's biprism experiment, Displacement of fringes, Interference in thin films, Wedge-shaped film, Newton's rings.

syllabus.head: Diffraction
syllabus.text: Single-slit diffraction, n-slit diffraction, Diffraction grating, Rayleigh's criterion of resolution, Resolving power of grating.

(ii) The diameters of the bright rings are proportional to the square root of odd natural numbers (D<sub>n</sub> ∝ √(2n-1)).

labs.title: Newton's Rings Experimental Bench
points: 3D Components: Plano-convex spherical lens on optical flat glass plate, monochromatic sodium vapor lamp, 45° glass plate beam splitter, travelling microscope with moveable micrometer crosshairs.
Interactive Sliders: Radius of curvature R (0.5 m to 2.5 m), wavelength λ (400 nm to 700 nm), liquid medium refractive index μ (1.0 to 1.6).
Real-Time Visualization: Renders dynamic circular concentric fringes with a central dark spot; calculates air film thickness t(r) = r2/2R; generates live Dn2 vs. n slope graph to extract λ and μ.

labs.title: Spectrometer & Grating Resolution Simulator
points: 3D Components: Collimator tube, central spectrometer turntable with plane transmission diffraction grating, telescope tube with vernier scale.
Interactive Sliders: Slit width a, slit separation b, ruling density N (lines/cm), dual wavelength source controls (λ1, λ2).

Real-Time Visualization: Continuous intensity distribution curve I(θ); dynamic interactive visualization of Rayleigh's resolution limit showing when two spectral peaks are unresolved, just resolved, and fully separated.

syllabus.head: Polarization
syllabus.text: Phenomenon of double refraction, Ordinary and extraordinary rays, Nicol prism, Production and analysis of plane-polarized light, Retardation plates (quarter-wave and half-wave plates), Circularly and elliptically polarized light, Optical activity, Specific rotation, Laurent's half-shade polarimeter.

syllabus.text: Principle of laser action, Einstein's coefficients, Population inversion, Optical pumping, Construction and working of He-Ne laser and Ruby laser, Applications of lasers.

syllabus.head: Optical Fiber
syllabus.text: Fundamental principles of optical fibers, Step-index and graded-index fibers, Single-mode and multimode fibers, Acceptance angle and acceptance cone, Numerical aperture, Light propagation mechanism, Optical communication system, Fiber losses and attenuation.

syllabus.head: Electromagnetics
syllabus.text: Gradient, Divergence, Curl, Gauss's theorem, Stokes' theorem, Continuity equation, Ampere's law, Displacement current, Maxwell's equations in differential and integral forms, Electromagnetic wave propagation in free space and conducting media, Transverse nature of EM waves, Poynting theorem and Poynting vector.

syllabus.text: Basic concepts of dia-, para-, and ferro-magnetism, Atomic origins of magnetic dipoles, Langevin's theory of diamagnetism, Phenomenon of magnetic hysteresis (B-H loop), Retentivity, Coercivity, and Hysteresis loss.

syllabus.head: Wave Mechanics
syllabus.text: Photoelectric effect, Compton effect (shift and scattered wavelength), Wave nature of particles, de Broglie matter waves, Free-particle wave function and wave packets, Group velocity and Phase velocity and their relation, Heisenberg's uncertainty principle and applications.

labs.title: Hall Effect Measurement Bench
points: 3D Components: Rectangular semiconducting slab (L ×w ×t) mounted between electromagnet pole pieces, constant current power supply leads, transverse digital Hall microvoltmeter probes.
Interactive Sliders: Sample material selector (N-Type Germanium vs. P-Type Silicon), current slider Ix, magnetic field slider Bz.

Real-Time Visualization: Animated charge carrier paths drifting and deflecting sideways under the Lorentz force F⃗ = q(v⃗d ×B⃗); accumulation of charges building the transverse Hall electric field EH; digital display of Hall voltage VH = (I B)/(n q t); calculates carrier concentration n, carrier sign, and Hall mobility μH.

labs.title: Optoelectronic Device & Solar Cell Simulator
points: 3D Components: Microscopic 3D P-N junction slice with depletion region, energy band diagram (Ec, Ev, EF), external circuit with variable load resistor RL.
Interactive Sliders: Mode toggle (LED Mode vs. Solar Cell Mode), forward bias voltage slider, incident solar irradiance slider (0 to 1500 W/m2).
LED Mode: Forward bias injects carriers; radiative electron-hole recombination emits photons with color linked to bandgap energy (λ= hc/Eg).

Solar Cell Mode: Incident photons generate electron-hole pairs; built-in junction field separates charges; dynamically draws the illuminated 4th-quadrant I-V characteristic curve to determine Voc, Isc, and maximum operating power point (Pmax).
